policy: Issues discovered during Phase 21 execution. Open items are honest blockers/limits, not hidden failures. Append-only across phases.

items.title: Timeline page cursor is index-based and can shift as history grows
items.detail: GetTimelinePage.before_sequence indexes the ordered event list rebuilt per request; concurrent history growth can shift page boundaries (repeat/skip at edges). Read-only review surface only.
items.resolutionPath: Replace with stable cursor over (observedUnixMs, semanticIdentitySha256, sourceId) via additive wire tag when the timeline becomes authoritative beyond review.

items.title: svelte-check could not run on the extracted tree (partial node_modules stub)
items.detail: The archive ships a 6-entry node_modules stub; vite 8 imports rolldown which was absent, so svelte-check failed to load vite.config. Renderer baseline was therefore not measurable until dependencies were restored.
items.resolution: Ran pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in apps/ui (pnpm-lock.yaml is part of the sealed tree). node_modules is gitignored and excluded from delivery manifests; baseline restored to exactly 0 errors / 17 warnings before any renderer edits.

items.title: Response payload oneof required a second new tag for timeline_page
items.detail: Initial plan allocated response tag 45 only (recurrence_patterns). Wiring get_timeline_page showed RPC replies also need their own payload variant distinct from the stream envelope tag 34; tag 46 was allocated additively.
items.resolution: operations.proto Response payload tags 45 and 46 added; both frozen by the extended audit wire-freeze gate.

items.title: Flaky parallel-test collision in driver-install coordinator tests (static temp path)
items.detail: temp_root() in crates/driver-install/tests/coordinator.rs derived its scratch directory from process id + wall-clock nanos only. Under `cargo test --workspace` the test threads of one binary share a clock; two tests starting in the same nanosecond tick produced the same path and both opened state.db, panicking protection_barrier_precedes_every_fake_mutation_and_completes at Database::open (UNIQUE/WAL contention). Reproduced intermittently by the supervisor during Phase 22 re-verification.
items.rootCause: Timestamp-only uniqueness is not collision-free for concurrent callers on coarse clocks.
items.fix: temp_root() now anchors uniqueness in a function-local AtomicU32 sequence counter (process-wide, std only, no new dependencies) combined with pid + instant-nanos suffix: 'aethercore-phase3-coordinator-{pid}-{seq}-{nanos}'. Applied to every call site via the shared helper.
items.evidence: 10 consecutive isolated runs of `cargo test -p aethercore-driver-install --test coordinator` all green (4 passed each); two consecutive full `cargo test --workspace --jobs 2 --no-fail-fast` runs both reported exactly 343 passed / 0 failed.
